helpers.name: Vlasov.convolveLipschitz_inner_lipschitz
helpers.one_line_math: For any fixed x and v in PhysSpace d, the function y ↦ ⟨gradW(x−y), v⟩ is LipschitzWith (L * ‖v‖₊): compose the L-Lipschitz map y ↦ gradW(x−y) with the ‖v‖₊-Lipschitz linear map w ↦ ⟨w, v⟩.

helpers.name: Vlasov.convolveLipschitz_KR_le
helpers.one_line_math: For any 1-Lipschitz function φ : PhysSpace d → ℝ, the integral difference ∫ φ dρ − ∫ φ dσ is bounded by (wasserstein1 ρ σ).toReal, directly from the Kantorovich–Rubinstein supremum definition of wasserstein1.

helpers.name: Vlasov.convolveLipschitz_inner_bound
helpers.one_line_math: For any v : PhysSpace d with ‖v‖ ≤ 1, the real inner product ⟨(∇W∗ρ)(x) − (∇W∗σ)(x), v⟩ is bounded by L · W₁(ρ, σ).toReal: unfold convolveFunctionMeasure, linearise the inner product through the integral difference, then apply convolveLipschitz_KR_le to the (L·‖v‖₊ / L)-rescaled 1-Lipschitz integrand.

helpers.name: Vlasov.convolveLipschitz_norm_le_of_inner_forall
helpers.one_line_math: If every unit vector v with ‖v‖ ≤ 1 satisfies ⟨z, v⟩ ≤ C, then ‖z‖ ≤ C: take v = z / ‖z‖ (the maximiser) to get ‖z‖ = ⟨z, z/‖z‖⟩ ≤ C, handling the z = 0 case separately.

residual_glue.strategy: Apply convolveLipschitz_norm_le_of_inner_forall with C = L * (wasserstein1 ρ σ).toReal and z = the difference vector, citing convolveLipschitz_inner_bound for the universal inner-product bound.
residual_glue.tactic_sketch:
exact convolveLipschitz_norm_le_of_inner_forall d gradW L hL ρ σ x
  (convolveLipschitz_inner_bound gradW L hL ρ σ x)
